_about: Experiment settings for brief v2. Vehicle, routes, dynamics and gear controller come from config/vehicle_route.json (copied unchanged from the v1 reference case).
_budget_note: Whole-route simulations per resolution, identical for A/B/C. Cache hits are free and counted separately; the cache is per search with the same policy for every method. Method C is additionally charged for its coarse solves when reporting cumulative calls.

A.label: A: scalar NM inner, flat start (historical)

C.label: C: bisection inner, inherited coarse profile

D.label: D (extra): C + safeguarded secant splits + scoring at |r| <= 0.02 s

multistart._note: Outer simplex = start + p * e_i. 'random:s' = seeded uniform(-0.3, 0.3) per section (numpy default_rng(s)).

finish_speed._note: New experimental choice (brief v2): optimised car must finish within 0.2 m/s of the constant-throttle car, inside the original time window. Seeded with the feasible constant profile.
